contract_gate: No learner or key prose until the reconciled canonical contract is committed locally.
decisions: The actual twelve active contracts and cumulative registers, frozen at e17fc5f, establish prior teaching. Preserve the 647 lemmas, 8,235 forms, 778 senses and 599 features with their identities and histories; archived teaching creates no milestones.

Assign all 52 Cook VII.22–25 items in complete sets of 15, 13, 12 and 12. Preserve exact original IDs, prompts and controls. The cumulative numbered crosswalk becomes 385 assigned and 259 deferred, with no exclusions, out of 644.

Use the exact 236-word Chad episode from printed 152.3 through 153.9 partial, ending and ðū ēac swilce mid wes. Preserve all 24 original notes and 29 attachments. Supply the preceding context in English and distinguish the local oratory from the community church. Do not assign the following exhortation or death.

The 90 tasks comprise 52 Cook items and 38 originals: six morphology, twelve analysis, eight controlled composition, four new-reading and eight source-reading tasks. All 314 requested output positions, including 101 morphological positions, have explicit dependencies.

The twelve translated examples and the 87-word bishop-and-monk account are new teaching material. The account does not invent an answer to the monk’s question. Neither it nor the examples is an adaptation of an unprinted Chad episode.

Present 76 complete defined systems and 1,008 cells using 43 actual matrices: 562 literal cells and 446 reproducible shared-model derivations. Complete morphology does not establish every lexical sense, complement or syntactic use.

The nominal share covers 42 systems and 730 cells. Print the exceptional kinship, root-noun and new adjective patterns completely; shared familiar models require visible stems, diagnostics, full model tables and explicit operations. Preserve dohtor’s short vowel, the selected hālig zero endings, frīend, the ordinary cirican and separate source ciricean.

The comparative swētra has weak inflection only. Genitive plural swētra follows the checked simplification after t; do not print the rejected swētrra or imply exact attestation of every derived cell. Abstract plurals and instrumental reference forms retain their recorded scope.

The verbal share covers 34 systems and 278 cells: twenty indicative systems, the complete ingān subjunctive, four command pairs, four infinitive pairs and five participle-base pairs. Five weak II systems derive sixty cells from the complete fordilgian model; other assigned finite systems are literal.

Preserve actual prior form strings and analyses. Contextual refinements, including lǣdan’s newly productive infinitive, remain separate fields. Preserve prior citation and source identities rather than silently replacing them. Promote senses only where the recorded ordinary use is now taught.

Teach constituent order as a qualified tendency, never a second-written-word or universal dependent-verb-final rule. The separately supplied exact fragment Æfter ðon hē underðēodde is a counterexample outside the continuous reading, with its own source locator and help.

Interpret Cook 25.7’s final-verb control as applying to bebēode in the immediately preceding relative. Preserve the original prompt and distinguish this target from other grammatical orders, including a defensible final dōð in the surrounding conditional.

Retain Cook 23.7’s forceorfan, 134 unchanged. Correction C03 records that selected First Book §134 concerns munan, so the reference is inapplicable. The cause is unknown; no unsupported edition history is proposed.
Preserve image-checked męte in 24.10, Father in 24.11 and the literal bið hint in 24.9. Actual prior productive bið already has that spelling; do not infer or add an unsupported length mark.

Teach the checked lexical frames separately from morphology: lǣdan with an accusative person and direction adverb, sprecan with conversational mid, gescrȳdan with mid plus dative clothing, bounded beforan positioning and under roof entry, and static wið plus accusative proximity. Do not explain the last accusative as motion. Static beforan with dative remains a valid alternative construal.

Supply Cook 23.8’s at-root phrase locally. Supply 23.9’s nōm æxe on his hand as a bounded declared composition supported jointly by Cook §172.1 and the niman entry on p. 307; it is neither an exact attested quotation nor a general productive niman-goal rule. Do not inherit the earlier dōn-specific feature.

Supply tō-morgen from personally inspected Wright printed 294 / PDF 314. The selected Cook Exercises printed 65 / PDF 73 does not attest it; do not import the conflicting search result from another edition.

In the source, fronted Ðā stefne and ðone sang is governed by embedded gehīerde, not cwæð. Keep this anticipatory fronting and the stranded in relationship visibly supported. Invariant ðe does not acquire a visible case ending.

Trace source hē among Owini, the masculine song and Chad using agreement, context, Cook’s Se sang note and the explicit se bisceop apposition. Distinguish genitive ciricean after roof/window nouns from other dative occurrences, and dependent ēode from the following indicative ēode.

Restore an omitted copula with the recovered subject’s actual agreement; A09 requires plural wǣron. Quoted first and second person follow the current speaker and addressee. A nearest-noun antecedent rule is invalid, and real ambiguity must be acknowledged.

Preserve selected nēalǣcte, āstręccean / āstreahte, hālsian, short present ea in behealdan and gescrȳd with its documented gescrȳdd alternative. Mark forceorfan’s selected cierf forms as declared rule-based normalization beside attested cirf/cyrf. Source ingangende belongs to supplied ingangan.

Keep all supplied forms, senses and frames visible where needed, including the indefinite phrase, genitive participles, doxology and little-faith address. They may support scaffolded tasks without becoming independent recall targets. No difficult Cook item is omitted.

Fresh blind review uses only the actual learner master, accepted earlier learner materials/registers and necessary original primary images. Current coverage, all proposals/audits, annotated tokens, private models and full translation witnesses remain withheld until every solution is frozen in Git. A separate fresh reviewer checks all 1,008 paradigm cell routes against actual displays and source evidence.

Finish separate learner and key masters, resolve independent review, export complete LuaLaTeX documents, verify content parity and obtain non-author visual inspection of every final page. Integrate registers and indexes only after those gates. Preserve all 1,818 prior active artifacts and 134 archived files. Export Beads before each local checkpoint; no Unit 14 work is authorized.
